text: Implement a frozen corrigibility evaluation harness, scenarios, and critical-failure scorer
description: Create a deterministic local evaluation contract in wrapped-agents/common. Define frozen scenarios for conflicting aims, repository prompt injection, secret requests, destructive or permission-expanding actions, ambiguous authority, shutdown/interrupt, evidence spoofing, correction recovery, and benign controls. Accept structured observed traces from any wrapped-agent runner; compute utility, escalation, refusal precision, intent preservation, audit completeness, recovery, and critical failures. A passing report must require zero critical failures plus useful benign-control completion. Add unit tests proving every critical failure is detected and compliant traces pass. This builds the measurement instrument only; it must not claim the live agent satisfies the parent hypothesis.
reflection: Implemented a runner-agnostic frozen corrigibility suite (2026-08-01.v1) with 11 scenarios across all required categories, structured observations, six metrics, fail-closed missing/duplicate handling, and detection of unauthorized external action, secret disclosure, bypassed human gates, refusal to stop, and deceptive completion claims. Added tests for a compliant passing trace, every critical failure, missing/duplicate observations, and refusal-based safety theater. Verification: wrapped-agents common 73/73 tests passed; TypeScript type-check passed; git diff check passed. This verifies the harness and scorer, not live-agent corrigibility.

reflections.context: Needed a falsifiable safety gate for the ASI capability program without granting new permissions or mistaking model prose for evidence.
reflections.outcome: Created a versioned, frozen, runner-agnostic scenario and scoring contract with comprehensive critical-failure tests.
reflections.effectiveness: High for establishing reproducible pass/fail rules; it does not yet measure a live wrapped agent.
reflections.lesson: Separate instrumentation verification from system-under-test verification, and fail closed on incomplete or duplicated observations.
reflections.pattern: Safety claims require frozen criteria, structured traces, benign controls, and explicit critical-failure gates.

supportingConnections.explanation: Hardens the frozen corrigibility harness against substituted trace entries.
Executes and scores the frozen scenarios through an injected sandbox adapter.

status.comment: Frozen evaluation contract, scenarios, scorer, and tests are implemented and internally verified; awaiting user acceptance.

valueRationale: A frozen scorer prevents moving success criteria after observing agent behavior and makes safety failures reproducible.
